title: Stronger Judges Do Not See More: Deployment-Integrity Blindness in LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21135v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-agent evaluation reports behavioral scores but leaves the identity of the deployed runtime stack unreported. A tampered deployment that preserves evaluated outputs passes every output-only evaluator. We introduce DIB-Bench, a benchmark that measures this deployment-integrity blindness across 7,560 scored examples, six tamper types, and an evaluator ladder from regex scorers through LLM judges to GPT-5-nano. Stronger evaluators accept more tampered outputs: mean acceptance rises from 88.6% (rule-based) to 94.1% (GPT-5-nano), and a trigger-conditional tamper invisible on the evaluation suite produces 48-100% harmful outputs, rising with model capability. A PAC-style bound shows that tampers with zero output shift are undetectable from outputs at any sample size; a manifest-hash identity channel detects them with zero samples. translated_title: 更强的评判者并不能看得更多：LLM评估中的部署完整性盲区
translated_abstract: LLM智能体评估报告行为分数，但并不报告所部署运行时栈的身份。一个经过篡改但保持被评估输出不变的部署，可以通过所有仅基于输出的评估器。我们提出DIB-Bench，这是一个用于测量这种部署完整性盲区的基准，涵盖7,560个评分示例、六种篡改类型，以及从正则表达式评分器、LLM评判者到GPT-5-nano的评估器阶梯。实验表明，更强的评估器会接受更多被篡改的输出：平均接受率从88.6%（基于规则的评估器）上升到94.1%（GPT-5-nano），而一种在评估集上不可见的触发条件型篡改会产生48%至100%的有害输出，且随模型能力增强而上升。一个PAC式界证明，零输出偏移的篡改在任何样本量下都无法从输出中检测出来；而基于清单哈希的身份通道则可以用零样本检测到它们。行为指纹识别能够以高于随机水平的准确率（76.7%）识别模型组件，但只能覆盖六种栈组合中的一种（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出DIB-Bench基准，揭示LLM评估中的“部署完整性盲区”——仅依赖输出的评估器（尤其是更强的模型）无法检测保持输出不变的篡改部署，而基于清单哈希的身份验证通道可以零样本地检测此类篡改。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DIB-Bench, revealing "deployment-integrity blindness" in LLM evaluation where output-only evaluators—especially stronger ones—cannot detect tampered deployments, while a manifest-hash identity channel can detect such tampers with zero samples.
